notes.title: Puzzle improvements & Update
notes.content:
Hey!
It's great to see some players have already managed to finish the game! Someone is even quite close to completing all puzzles.

However we are seeing players get bogged down in the second world so we decided to slightly reduce the difficulty of some of those puzzles. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597055/2a92713468384e6644ce9bb58ae02fbfa883f870.png[/img]
Feel free to use the steam forum to ask for help if you really can't get past a puzzle :).

Enjoy!
